messages:
riley: Posted a fresh draft of the launch blog + webinar CTA plan. Link: https://drive.redwood/launchs/sep2026-draft
mia: skim look good. headline needs a crisp one-liner about latency — put the 95th percentile number in the hero.
jason: suggestion: include a short 2-slide PDF as a lead magnet for ppl who want quick benchmarks. could be gated.
eleanor: if we gate, add a short methodology note and a link to the full benchmark repo so researchers can trust the number.
devin: legal flag: the phrase 'industry-best' is risky without proof. recommend 'among top open models on our benchmark' or drop it.
laura: timeline note: blog publish Wed 08:00 PT, webinar invite goes with the blog as primary push. press list send scheduled Thu morning.
tom: SEO check: meta title < 70 chars, meta description should include 'inference cost' & 'latency' keywords. I can draft.
kate: HubSpot form plan: hidden fields = utm_campaign, utm_source, variant, model_reference, webinar_id. Also add checkbox opt-in for product emails.
oliver: A/B ideas: subject line A = 'See how to cut inference costs', B = 'How we serve LLMs at 40% lower cost' — but legal needs number backed up.
ops-bot: reminder: publish checklist task #12 (confirm CTA routing and HS form) assigned to kate due 2026-09-22.
riley: noted. I'll swap 'industry-best' per Devin and link methodology per Eleanor. Jason — happy to use a 2-slide PDF; should be on the same landing so gating is straightforward.
mia: also recommend text under hero: one short sentence about tradeoffs (latency vs cost) so readers know it's pragmatic.
jason: customer quote? if we have a one-liner from Marco or Nikhil about cost improvements that'd help conversion.
laura: press embargo window: pls don't share quotes publicly until 09/23 10:00 PT.
kate: HubSpot dedupe rule: drop submissions from *@redwood.com and test domains; also strip utm_content param from internal links.
riley: calling final approvals: @mia for headline placement, @devin for legal wording, @tom for SEO. Need thumbs by EOD tomorrow.
oliver: I'll create two email subject variants and two preview text options; will upload tests to Mktg folder.
ops-bot: status update: checklist #12 moved to 'in progress' by kate.
riley: thanks team — will post updated draft with changes tomorrow AM and tag for final sign-off.
